scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name general-boss --branch main
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name general-boss --branch preview
scripts.deploy:tail: wrangler pages deployment tail --project-name general-boss --environment production
scripts.project:create: wrangler pages project create general-boss --production-branch main
